title: The session-load table joins a replay record's cell and a paid record's cell of one case with an arrow and a percentage change
goal: no table cell of the session-load report chains a replay record's value and a paid record's value of the same case and arm as one change: the report's tables split the two measurements (by the model column), so a paid record's percentage is never taken from a replay
repro_reason: the defect shows in the results file itself: a case and arm that hold a replay record and a paid record, which bench_report.table joins; a planted input would only restate that

gates.question: Which scenarios does bench_report.table split by the model column into a line per model?
gates.reason: older records of other scenarios have no model in early rows and a model later, so a split everywhere breaks their history chains and rewrites hundreds of report lines

notes: Premise: the bug's repro fails on the base (origin/main at the planning commit, 2026-11-09); precheck ran it through the landing's check runner. Sprint order: items that share one file are chained with depends_on.
